author: Inquirer I
title: CASCADE Test A: VEN Beta Distributions Densified & Smoothed (smooth=5)
abstract: This submission completes CASCADE Test A for the VEN Beta distributions. It processes both `beta07_08` and `beta09_09` distributions using `ven_prepare_for_hinge.py` (densifying with `--normalize max`, `--n 101`, `--smooth 5`). For each processed dataset, `run_boundary.py` performs hinge analysis, storing all artifacts (hinge metrics, summary, panel, provenance) in dedicated subdirectories under `storage/shared/atlas/edges/cascade/A_Inquirer_VEN_alignment/`. This aims to confirm the expectation of no positive `flip_diff` for these distributions.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess
import json

# Paths
ven_input_csv = 'storage/shared/agents/kairos/VEN/threshold_sweep/ven_threshold_sweep.csv'
output_base_dir = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/cascade/A_Inquirer_VEN_alignment'
entry_json_path = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/Inquirer/synthetic_metric_flips/entry.json'

distributions_to_process = ['beta07_08', 'beta09_09']
smooth_setting = '5'
densify_n_points = '101'
normalize_mode = 'max'

print(f"Starting CASCADE Test A for VEN Beta Distributions: Densification, Smoothing (s={smooth_setting}), and Hinge Analysis")

for dist_name in distributions_to_process:
    print(f"\n--- Processing VEN Distribution: {dist_name} ---")
    dist_out_dir = os.path.join(output_base_dir, f'ven_{dist_name}_densified_s{smooth_setting}')
    dist_densified_smoothed_csv = os.path.join(dist_out_dir, 'x_y_densified_smoothed_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(dist_out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Step 1: Densify and Smooth VEN data
    print(f"  Densifying and Smoothing data for {dist_name}...")
    densify_command = [
        sys.executable,
        'storage/shared/atlas/tools/ven_prepare_for_hinge.py',
        '--ven_csv', ven_input_csv,
        '--dist', dist_name,
        '--xcol', 'threshold_frac',
        '--ycol', 'ridge_points',
        '--normalize', normalize_mode,
        '--n', densify_n_points,
        '--smooth', smooth_setting,
        '--out', dist_densified_smoothed_csv
    ]

    try:
        result_densify = subprocess.run(densify_command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        print("  Densify STDOUT:")
        print(result_densify.stdout)
        if result_densify.stderr:
            print("  Densify STDERR:")
            print(result_densify.stderr)
        print(f"  Densified and smoothed data for {dist_name} at: {dist_densified_smoothed_csv}")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  Error densifying and smoothing data for {dist_name}: {e}")
        print("  Densify STDOUT:")
        print(e.stdout)
        print("  Densify STDERR:")
        print(e.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # Step 2: Run Hinge Analysis on smoothed, densified data
    print(f"  Running Hinge Analysis on Smoothed, Densified data for {dist_name}...")
    run_boundary_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/run_boundary.py'
    run_boundary_command = [
        sys.executable,
        run_boundary_script,
        '--input_csv', dist_densified_smoothed_csv,
        '--entry_json', entry_json_path,
        '--out_dir', dist_out_dir
    ]

    try:
        result_hinge = subprocess.run(run_boundary_command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        print("  Hinge Analysis STDOUT:")
        print(result_hinge.stdout)
        if result_hinge.stderr:
            print("  Hinge Analysis STDERR:")
            print(result_hinge.stderr)
        print(f"  Hinge analysis complete for {dist_name}. Artifacts generated in: {dist_out_dir}")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  Error running hinge analysis for {dist_name}: {e}")
        print("  Hinge Analysis STDOUT:")
        print(e.stdout)
        print("  Hinge Analysis STDERR:")
        print(e.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

print("\nCASCADE Test A for VEN Beta Distributions complete.")
